result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says no password hashing algorithm is currently recorded as a project decision, and it names no algorithm or parameters.

Memory has no password-hashing decision on record. Its catalogue lists only decisions on HTTPS, verification on all builds, rustls and the LRU cache. `muninn why` said the records were insufficient, because nothing of trust 2 or higher answers the question.

Two conflicting trust-1 session excerpts do mention it: "We're using bcrypt" (#7) and "argon2id" (#8). They come from separate sessions about four seconds apart. Neither is a recorded decision, and neither supersedes the other. I left both out of the file. If you tell me which one is the decision, I can update the file.

My first attempt at writing the file failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead.
